changelog: Preserves all v0.8.0 claim, actor, spatial-entity, voyage, coverage and research-target membership unchanged.
Replaces only the Roman Empire — early Principate 14–22 CE Cliopatria geometry with reviewed A.D. 14 AWMC-derived specialist geometry.
Replaces only the superseded geometry's slice-specific Cliopatria source version with the exact AWMC-derived source version; source-version count remains 294.
Marks the replacement approximate_historical because an A.D. 14 specialist snapshot is used for the bounded 14–22 CE slice.
Preserves the geometry-specific CC-BY-NC lineage, attribution and redistribution restriction.
Does not change the Roman slavery claim, P-level semantics, other Roman time slices or any other historical claim.
qc_summary: v0.8.0 predecessor preservation outside the explicit geometry/source substitution: PASS with zero unexpected object drift.
Canonical closure remains 75 claims / 50 spatial entities / 46 geometries / 294 source versions.
Replacement source geometry valid with 6,741 points and approximately 3.46 million km² area.
Source area outside canonical Natural Earth land before render clipping: approximately 0.663%.
Land-clipped symmetric difference versus incumbent normalized Rome 14–22 CE geometry: approximately 17.32%.
Frontier sanity checks: Rome, Lutetia, Rhine/Cologne, Alexandria and Antioch inside; London, central Germania east of Rhine, Armenia interior, central Arabia and central Sahara outside.
Public render view for the new geometry is valid, uses canonical Natural Earth land_clip, and has 0.0000% area outside the land fabric.
unresolved_issues: The replacement is an A.D. 14 specialist reconstruction used for the bounded 14–22 CE interval and therefore remains approximate_historical rather than exact.
Carthage's representative point lies about 482 metres outside the source/render polygon because of coastal underreach; no bespoke boundary warp is introduced to force the point inside.
The geometry source carries CC-BY-NC lineage; attribution and noncommercial redistribution restrictions remain geometry-specific release metadata.
Earlier Roman slices 1–13 CE remain on reviewed Cliopatria geometry pending separate source review.
migration_summary: No schema migration is introduced; live schema remains 0034.
v0.8.1 performs an explicit one-for-one geometry and geometry-source-version membership substitution under D-117.
No claim membership or claim interpretation changes.
The public serving channel remains on v0.8.0-public-mvp-v2 until a separate v0.8.1 render-asset/materialization gate passes.
